name: Warm Homes Nest
support: Recorded open: free tailored insulation, heating, heat pumps and solar for qualifying households.
caveat: Household eligibility unknown. Income, benefit/health, EPC and property checks apply. Battery support is unconfirmed.

name: Green Homes Wales
support: Recorded open subject to funding: funded assessment, £1,000–£25,000 interest-free loan and discretionary grant alongside the loan. Solar with battery is an eligible measure.
caveat: Primary owner-occupied residence and affordability checks required. Loan is not a grant; no grant amount can be assumed before an individual offer. Listed/conservation restrictions apply.

name: ECO4
support: Recorded open to 31 December 2026: supplier-funded insulation and heating; solar only under specific heating-system conditions.
caveat: EPC D–G and household eligibility checks required. Supplier decides funding; no guaranteed award. Standalone battery support is not established.

name: Gwynedd ECO4 Flex
support: Local ECO4 referral route for insulation/heating; reported gross-income route below £31,000 plus alternative qualifying routes.
caveat: Household eligibility and current referral intake unconfirmed. Council referral does not guarantee supplier funding; do not add a separate Flex award to ECO4.

name: Boiler Upgrade Scheme
support: Recorded £7,500 for qualifying air-to-water/ground-source heat pumps; conditional £9,000 oil/LPG off-grid uplift from 21 July 2026 to 31 March 2027.
caveat: Eligibility and existing heating fuel unknown. Installer, replacement-system and technical conditions apply. Not a PV/battery grant. The report also lists £2,500 air-to-air and £5,000 qualifying biomass.

name: 0% VAT on energy-saving materials
support: Tax relief on qualifying installed PV, batteries, insulation, heat pumps and wind until 31 March 2027.
caveat: Tax relief, not a cash grant. Installer applies the correct rate. Do not deduct VAT again from a quote already using the zero rate.

name: Smart Export Guarantee
support: Ongoing supplier payments for eligible exported renewable electricity.
caveat: Export revenue, not installation funding. Certification, metering and supplier terms apply. Do not add another SEG payment to Flux export revenue already counted.

name: Warm Homes: Local Grant
support: Free energy-saving improvements for eligible private homes in England.
caveat: Not available in Wales; cannot support this Gwynedd property.

name: Warm Home Discount
support: Recorded reopening October 2026: £150 electricity-bill discount for qualifying households.
caveat: Bill support only, not a retrofit capital grant. Household benefits and 2026–27 eligibility remain unconfirmed.

name: Leasing Scheme Wales — Gwynedd
support: Up to £5,000 to improve energy rating within a qualifying 5–20-year council lease.
caveat: Conditional landlord route only. Not an ordinary owner-occupier/holiday-home grant; willingness and eligibility to lease to the council are unknown.

name: Gwynedd empty-home support
support: Up to £25,000 to bring a qualifying empty home back into use and improve efficiency.
caveat: Not a general retrofit grant. Empty/second-home history, local connection, Council Tax band A–D, income and mortgage conditions must be checked.

name: Menter Gwynedd: Decarbonisation Stream
support: Recorded 2026/27 EOI deadline: midnight 30 September 2026. £2,500–£12,000, up to 70% of eligible capital costs after business-support stage.
caveat: Ordinary residential use excluded. Holiday accommodation needs qualifying commercial use and business conditions; reported letting tests are 252 available days and 182 let days. Property use is unknown.
